notes: §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR9: "The first LINE NUMBER clause specified within a PAGE FOOTING report group must be an absolute LINE NUMBER clause." ScreenReportLineClauses walks the RD's entries, resets firstLineClause at each level-01 entry, and below 2002 refuses the group's first LINE operand when it is relative (PLUS, +, or NEXT PAGE without integer-1) in a page footing (COBOL2199). Probes at --std 85: a relative first LINE at level 01 (TYPE PF LINE PLUS 1) and at level 05 (the witness) refused; LINE + 1 refused twice (SR9 and the 2002 '+' gate, COBOL0900); an absolute first LINE 18 followed by LINE PLUS 1 ran and printed FT1 on line 18 and FT2 on line 19 of a 20-line page; a relative first LINE in a page heading is accepted; the witness compiles at --std 2002.

next.reason: 1985: "The first LINE NUMBER clause specified within a PAGE FOOTING report group must be an absolute LINE NUMBER clause."; 2023: "If the report group is a page footing, the line number is given by (FOOTING integer + integer-2).". 2023 GR-13.18.35.4-5 b)4 defines a relative first LINE clause in a page footing. No SR keeps the absolute-only restriction, so the 1985 requirement is dropped.
